card.name: Linking words before named syndromes
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "including", "similar in appearance to" or "and" that come right before a named syndrome, mainly Guillain-Barré syndrome or thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, in warning sections.

modes.label: Before Guillain-Barré
modes.description: "including" or "to" after demyelinating disorders, just before Guillain-Barré syndrome.
modes.example: peripheral demyelinating disorders,<< including>> Guillain-Barré syndrome. Avoid

modes.label: Before TTP and HUS
modes.description: "including" or "and" after thrombotic microangiopathy, leading into TTP or hemolytic uremic syndrome.
